title: EgerTickets
subtitle: Egerton University Event Ticketing Platform
desc: Egerton University's official event ticketing and discovery platform. Students can browse and book campus events across music, sports, concerts, conferences, and workshops — with secure checkout in seconds. Features an AI assistant chatbot, real-time event dashboards, an organizer portal, and a full booking management system.

title: M-Pesa Ticketing System
subtitle: Mobile Payment Integration
desc: Full-stack payment integration for events using Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB. Handles secure M-Pesa API transactions for Kenyan users.
